question: Anaphase B consists of:

options.opa: Displacement of the chromosomes towards the poles of the spindle.
options.opd: Separation of the poles of the spindle.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Anaphase B" -> "separation of spindle poles" -> "increased distance between poles" -> "chromosomes move apart" -> 90%
CHAIN: "Anaphase B" -> "spindle elongation" -> "separation of spindle poles" -> "chromosomes move towards poles" -> 85%
CHAIN: "Anaphase B" -> "separation of spindle poles" -> "movement of chromosomes" -> "completion of cell division" -> 80%
analysis: Anaphase B is characterized by the separation of the spindle poles, which is achieved by the elongation of polar microtubules and the sliding of overlapping microtubules past each other. This process increases the distance between the spindle poles, contributing to the overall separation of chromosomes. Therefore, the correct description of Anaphase B is the separation of the poles of the spindle.
